comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#1603): a design of format 39 keeps the body a Join To Object runs to apart. A 10 mm cube Body1 (1000); a 2 x 2 square sketched at z 20 extruded down to the cube's top (40) with no targets, so none but the cube, kept apart; another one with the cube as its only target (40). Each tool is a body of its own on the cube: 3 bodies, 1080 in all.
